## What changed

- `lat search` now embeds with multi-qa-MiniLM-L6-cos-v1, a local model trained on question and answer pairs. In one measurement it ranked the right section first for 9 of 32 questions, against 5 for the old model. `lat init` downloads it once from Hugging Face, pinned to one commit and checked by SHA-256, into the platform cache folder (`~/Library/Caches/lat` on macOS, `~/.cache/lat` on Linux). Every project on the machine shares that copy. Offline, or with `LAT_BUNDLED_EMBEDDING_MODEL=1`, a fresh index uses the bundled all-MiniLM-L6-v2 instead.
- An existing index keeps the model it was built with. Run `lat reindex` to switch it to multi-qa.
- Agent hooks never download the model. Only `lat init` and an explicit search or reindex do.
- New `lat search --rerank <url>` flag reorders results with a decision model at that URL, and keeps search order when the call fails. `LAT_RERANK_MODEL` names the model; `LAT_RERANK_KEY` is sent as a bearer token only when set.
- Fixed: `lat ui build server` failed because the vendored `@lat.md/server` package was missing its `package.json`. The vendoring script now copies the package's `dist/` and `package.json`, and rewrites only import specifiers.
- Fixed: the OpenCode discovery test ran a developer's global git hooks, which could start a flood of processes during `pnpm test`. The test now runs git with an empty global and system config.
